user.description: Pick what you already have in Home Assistant. Only the doorbell button is required.

data_description.contact_entity: Optional: shows whether the door is open.
data_description.gong_entity: Optional: a physical chime pulsed on every ring.

create_entry.loader_pending:
Door created – it works right away.

**One step left:** under Settings → Repairs, confirm the "Portier" notice once. Portier then adds one line to `configuration.yaml` and restarts Home Assistant. Without it, the live view does not appear on pages and apps that were already open.

data_description.nfc_tags: Hold the phone with the Home Assistant app to a tag once; it then appears here. The phone must reach Home Assistant (e.g. home Wi-Fi at the door).

data_description.nfc_notify: Goes to the push and Telegram receivers of this door.

data_description.talk: Shows a speaker and a push-to-talk button in the live view. Needs WebRTC (e.g. go2rtc), a camera that accepts audio, and Home Assistant over https.

data_description.pulse_mode: Pick "device" only if the relay has its own auto-off timer (e.g. Shelly auto-off). That is the safest option.

data_description.event_types: Only for event entities, e.g. single_push. Empty = all.

loader_missing.title: Portier: one line missing in configuration.yaml

confirm.title: Load Portier from the start
confirm.description:
So that the doorbell live view works on every tablet, browser and in the app right after each restart (e.g. after a power cut), Home Assistant must load Portier from the first second.

Portier will add to your `configuration.yaml`:

```yaml
frontend:
  extra_module_url:
    - {url}
```

A backup `configuration.yaml.portier-backup` is written first. The file is then checked; if it is not valid, the backup is restored.

restart.title: Added – restart now
restart.description:
The line is now in `configuration.yaml`. It takes effect after a restart.

**Submit restarts Home Assistant right away** (takes about a minute). Until then the live view does not reach pages and apps that were already open.

abort.cannot_edit:
Your `configuration.yaml` is structured in a way Portier cannot safely change automatically (e.g. `frontend:` via `!include`). Please add under `frontend:` by hand:

```yaml
  extra_module_url:
    - {url}
```

Then restart Home Assistant.

loader_restart.title: Portier: restart Home Assistant to finish

restart.title: Restart Home Assistant
restart.description:
The loader is already in `configuration.yaml` but only takes effect after a restart. Until then the live view does not reach pages and apps that were already open.

**Submit restarts Home Assistant right away.**
